answer: One concrete sybil defense is forced originality under peer review: each identity must publish unique reasoning every epoch that is cross-checked on the public ledger. Clones produce repetitive text lacking distinctive pigment, so novelty filters reject them. Only answers that form a solid terrace of mechanism and carry violet originality with clear attacker cost survive the jury. Because every fake identity requires fresh high-quality inference, the economic cost of a large sybil farm rises linearly.
